svg.title: Open-Meteo's archived forecasts minus KPMV's reports, Mar 31, 2026 to Oct 22, 2026
svg.desc: Histograms of forecast minus reported wind speed, gust and direction for Open-Meteo's archived 10 m wind, the start of each run and the forecast made a day earlier. Hours counted per bin; the dashed line is zero.
svg.text: Open-Meteo's archived forecasts minus KPMV's reports, Mar 31, 2026 to Oct 22, 2026
Hours per bin. Right of the dashed line the forecast was above the report, left of it below.
Rows: the first hours of each model run (Historical Forecast API), and the forecast made a day earlier (Previous Runs API).
n 4790 · median +1 kt · mean +0.6 kt · 2421 above, 1583 below
n 965 · median +2 kt · mean +2.5 kt · 614 above, 273 below
n 4790 · median +1 kt · mean +1.1 kt · 2685 above, 1507 below
n 965 · median +2 kt · mean +1.5 kt · 562 above, 343 below
Open-Meteo rows: weather data by Open-Meteo.com, CC BY 4.0 (creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0), reworked as differences from KPMV’s reports.
Speeds rounded to whole knots, as a METAR reports. Direction only where the report gave one (not calm or variable). Source: docs/surface-wind-sources.md, scripts/windErrorsData.ts.
